title: PUT performs full replacement of book fields (omitted optional fields reset to null)
evidence: book_api.erl:120-121 with_book builds a full field map; book_store.erl:59-62 update saves it wholesale. README.md:29 documents this as 'Replaces an existing book's fields'. Spec R5 asks only that update modify a book, so this is conformant; noted for cross-run comparison.
suggestion: No change required; a PATCH-style partial update is beyond spec.

title: Author filter is exact full-name match (case-sensitive), not substring
evidence: book_store.erl:45-50 matches Author =:= Name exactly; README.md:26 documents exact-match semantics; author_filter_test (book_api_tests.erl:37-48) confirms ?author=Borges returns []. Spec R3 only requires an ?author= filter, which this satisfies.
suggestion: No change required; substring/case-insensitive matching is beyond spec.
